home.title: Know what you're playing before you scratch.
home.intro: Compare every scratch card on sale: what each one pays back per €1, your chance of winning, which top prizes have already been claimed and which games are about to end.

footer.disclaimer: Estimates from public prize tables and claimed wins. Not affiliated with any lottery operator.

errors.noData: The data couldn't be loaded right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

allGames.title: All games
allGames.intro: Every ticket on sale, ranked by average return per €1.
allGames.note: Return per €1 removes big prizes already claimed; the amber line shows how much lower that is than on paper. "Ends" is the last day of sale announced by ONCE. "Low data" means too few claims seen to estimate sales reliably.

game.soldNote: Of the current series, estimated from wins
game.soldNoteLow: Rough estimate: few claims seen yet
game.historyNote: Adjusted return only drops below its on-paper value when big prizes are claimed. Share sold firms up as more claims are seen; early values rest on few. Shaded gaps are periods without data.
game.noHistory: Not enough history to chart yet.

wins.title: Recent wins
wins.note: Every claim is still stored and used in the return estimates; this filter only changes what the list shows. Times are Spanish local time.

archive.title: Inactive games
archive.intro: Games no longer on sale, since we started tracking in May 2026.
archive.noTopClaim: Ended with no top-prize claim seen
archive.note: Claims seen are those in the public winners list while we were tracking. Prizes in tickets never sold before a game ended are never claimed. "—" means no prize table was published.
